label: GO: choosing a2 right after a fresh reward (rewarded last trial, not the one before)
explanation: Fires only at GO (D1 and D2 essentially never), only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward=1 holds 99.9% of mass), and almost only when the agent is choosing a2 (model_act=2 / strongly negative choice logit; a1 choices get 5% of mass). Magnitude is greatest on the first rewarded GO after an unrewarded trial, e.g. after a rare-rewarded a1->S2 trial when the agent switches to a2 (top examples reach max). Along a run of consecutive rewarded a2 trials it decays quickly (about 0.2, then 0.03, then 0.01), so most false positives of the simpler predicate GO & prev_reward=1 & choose a2 (F1 0.64, mass recall 0.95, precision 0.48) are late steps in a rewarded streak. Adding the condition that the trial before last was not rewarded gives dev precision 0.69 and mass recall 0.88, but recall only 0.60, since weak activations continue into the streak. Recorded with model_act (the agent policy argmax at GO, which the agent computes itself) in place of the future action variable; the two score the same. It does not fire on unrewarded-history GO steps or on a1 choices. It roughly reads as a recent reward newly supporting a2 (S2 good).
